lock_basis: Written after inspecting pilot pairs 1-4 and collecting held-out pairs 5-12, but before inspecting held-out counts, features or deltas
primary_endpoint: Middle-window SBI count in benign_nrf minus middle-window SBI count in passive
model_choice: None; both conditions are benign and no independent anomaly labels exist
failure_policy: Report every planned pair and all failures; invalid pairs have null endpoint, not zero; no selective replacement or exclusion
pair_integrity: Recompute readiness, receipts, fixture matching and saved deltas; reject inconsistencies rather than trust summaries alone
grouping: Both conditions and all adjacent windows remain within the same pair partition
implementation_strata: Report acquisition source and parser hashes; do not silently merge differing collector implementations
label_basis: Declared benign/passive protocol conditions; not independent attack/vulnerability ground truth
